foundation.framingA.title: Wannan shine taronmu na farko.
foundation.framingA.body:
Tambayoyi bakwai masu shiru — amma za ka iya dakatar da su bayan uku ka ga karatun ka na farko.

Babu amsoshi da suka dace. Gaskiya yafi burgewa.

Wannan ba gwaji ba ne. Hoto ne na farko na inda kake a yanzu, don in iya saduwa da kai a can.
foundation.framingA.skip: Tsallaka yanzu — yi amfani da tsofaffi
foundation.framingB.title: Wannan shine tushe naka.
foundation.framingB.body:
Abin da ka ba ni ya zama ƙungiyar farawarka.

A cikin kwanaki masu zuwa zan ci gaba da daidaitawa — wannan ba gwaji ba ne, hoto ne na farko.
foundation.q1.title: Wanne daga cikin waɗannan al'amuran ke tasiri a gare ka yanzu?
foundation.q1.subtitle: Har zuwa 3. Kasance da gaskiya.
foundation.q1.opt1: Ba isa ba — Ba na yin isasshe
foundation.q1.opt7: Fushi / fushi — yana tashi da sauri
foundation.q2.title: Wane saurin motsa jiki kake iya kiyayewa yanzu?
foundation.q2.subtitle: Ba buri ba. Abin da rayuwar ku ta yanzu za ta ba ku.
foundation.q2.opt1: A hankali — wani karamin al'ada, mai dorewa har abada
foundation.q2.opt2: Matsakaici — aikin yau da kullum, matsakaicin ƙarfi
foundation.q2.opt3: Mai tsauri — Ina son tapas, ina son ya ƙone
foundation.q2.opt4: Gidan sufi — Ina son yawancin rana a ciki
foundation.q3.title: Lokacin da kake mafarkin mafi kyawun kanka, su ne...
foundation.q3.opt2: Cikin soyayya — wargaje cikin wani abu mafi girma
foundation.q3.opt3: Mai kauri — mai ratsa kowane abu
foundation.q3.opt4: Mai hikima — shiru, mai haske, wasu suna zuwa wurinsu
foundation.q3.opt5: Tsakanin duniyoyi — ganin abin da wasu ba za su iya gani ba
foundation.q3.opt6: Kasancewa mai natsuwa wanda mutane ke samun warkarwa kusa da su
foundation.q3.opt7: Cike da rai — mai shiga rai, na kusa, a nan
foundation.q3.opt8: Yin wani abu da duniya ba ta taba gani ba
foundation.q3.opt10: Kin abin karya — ko da kai kadai ne
foundation.q3.opt11: Kai kadai a duwatsu, ba tare da shagala ba
foundation.q3.opt12: Da amfani — ƙananan ayyuka, an yi su da kyau
foundation.q4.title: Wace ƙofa ce mafi kusa da kai a yanzu?
foundation.q4.opt5: Jiki mai tsarki — numfashi, ƙarfi, sakawa
foundation.q4.opt6: Aikin ƙarfi — numfashi, dabarar ciki, rayuwa
foundation.q5.title: Me kake nan don sake tunani akai?
foundation.q5.opt1: Wani imani da na riƙe tun ina yaro
foundation.q5.opt4: Yadda nake kula da wannan jiki
foundation.q5.opt5: Abin da na yarda da jin shi
foundation.q5.opt7: Abin da nake ginawa zuwa gare shi
foundation.q6.title: Wanne ya fi gaskiya?
foundation.q6.opt1: Rayuwa tana faruwa a gare ni
foundation.q6.opt2: Ina da zaɓi a yadda nake amsawa
foundation.q6.opt4: Fahimta ce kawai ta ke akwai
foundation.q7.title: Lokacin da wani abu mai wuya ya faru, ina kake zuwa da farko?
foundation.q7.subtitle: Lura da motsi na farko sosai.
foundation.q7.opt1: A cikin kaina — bincike, shiryawa, sake kunnawa
foundation.q7.opt2: A zuciyata — ji, kai ga wani
foundation.q7.opt3: Zuwa ga aiki — matsa, gyara, yi wani abu
foundation.q8.title: Yaya ka saba da kallon tunaninka?
foundation.q8.opt1: Sabon abu gaba daya a gare ni
foundation.q8.opt4: Yanki ne mai ƙarfi na rayuwata
foundation.analysis.subtitle: Wannan zai canza yayin da kake aiki. Ba a gyara komai ba — shi ne babban manufar.
foundation.analysis.bandNote: Za mu sake karanta wannan duk ƴan kwanaki. Rukunai suna motsawa. Shi ne babban manufar.
foundation.brain.head.label: Wanda kansa ke jagoranta
foundation.brain.heart.label: Wanda zuciyarsa ke jagoranta
foundation.analysis.returnNote: Kuna iya komawa zuwa ga karatun ku daga baya daga Setaftino. Babu wani abu da ya karshe.
foundation.paths.title: Zaɓi abokan tafiyarka.
foundation.paths.subtitle: Lura ita ce tushe — kowane hanya a nan take fara. Zaɓi hanyoyi 2–3 da suke da rai a gare ku yanzu. Kuna iya ƙara wasu daga baya.
foundation.paths.observationDesc: Kallo abin da yake akwai, ba tare da kamawa ko tura shi ba. Kowane hanya da muke tafiya tare tana farawa daga wannan zama.
foundation.paths.startingPoint: Wannan shine wurin farko da kake — ba kurkuku ba. Hanyarka za ta canza yayin da kake canzawa.
foundation.archetype.creator: Mahalicci
foundation.path.kriya.blurb: Aikin makamashi ta hanyar numfashi da dabarun ciki.
foundation.path.karma.blurb: Aiki ba tare da son zuciya ba. Hidima a matsayin addu'a.
foundation.path.jnana.blurb: Bincike. Yanke ta hanyar ruɗi tare da fayyace.
foundation.path.tantra.blurb: Komai mai tsarki ne. Ba a ware komai ba.
foundation.path.dhyana.blurb: Zama a shuru. Zurfafa ta hanyar natsuwa.
